brand.name: Cool Crypto Games
brand.productLine: Browse freely. Watch freely. Connect to play. Never pay to play.

typography.display: Archivo (SIL OFL), 600-900. Chosen for the wordmark's register.
typography.body: Use a highly legible open sans-serif
typography.caseRule: Display headings uppercase and heavy; labels 10-11px uppercase with wide tracking; body sentence case. Hierarchy comes from size and weight, not from case.

motion.reducedMotion: Disable non-essential parallax, glow travel, and large transforms

usageRules.acid: Primary play, register, live, and verified states only
usageRules.orange: Alerts, expiring states, and rare event emphasis only
usageRules.glow: Use sparingly around active or live elements; never on body text
usageRules.crypto: Platform surfaces: no charts, coins, rockets, moons, or market imagery, and never live market data. Game content is exempt — a game may depict charts, candlesticks or bonding curves as subject matter.
usageRules.contentTruth: Never display generated-image statistics as real product data

colorNotes: Sampled from the supplied brand sheet and app reference, replacing the founding acid/cobalt pair. accent is the mark's own square: 5.4:1 on the ground, so it is safe as text and as an icon. White on an accent fill is 3.5:1, which meets AA for large text only, so .ccg-btn-primary sets its label at 19px/900; smaller controls use the accent as text rather than as a fill. Chrome is neutral so a game's cover is the most saturated thing on any screen.
radiusNotes: Square. The sheet has no rounded control on it; 'pill' is kept as a name so existing class names resolve to a rectangle in one place.

assets.source: Supplied brand sheet and lockup export.
assets.note: Keyed to transparency from the sheet's one-colour panels and issued in both inks with the accent square kept. Nothing is redrawn.
